_why: Same test as the apex host: advertise the pages we stand behind instead of all 98. Google crawled 70 of these and indexed none, so the old list was not buying crawl attention — it was buying a verdict. This is sitemap scope only: nothing is deleted, nothing is noindexed, every page stays live and linked from /game/ and the tag hubs. Reversible by removing an entry and rebuilding.
_review: 2026-11-18 — re-run check_indexation.py for play and compare.
_note: Slugs are the game's own link tail (normalizeHref), not a slugified title — Eaglercraft is published as /game/m/minecraft/, Big Tower Tiny Square as /game/b/btts/, Ninja Blade as /game/n/ninjablade/. Selection rule: the 14 games already carrying the editor's `featured` flag, minus the two thinnest (math-game, troll-boxing), plus six titles that carry real search demand independent of this catalogue (2048, Wordle, Pac-Man, Temple Run 2, Tube Jumpers, There Is No Game). Tags kept are the six with the largest real inventory and least overlap with the two-player hub (apex /2-player-games, play /tag/multiplayer/).
